name: 本地化 - 香港 Hong Kong
summary: 提供繁體中文(香港)翻譯。
description:
以官方繁體中文為基礎，將一些詞語改成(我認為)香港慣用的翻譯及改善某些質素較差的疑似AI翻譯。
一邊玩一邊更新。

en.name: Localization - Traditional Chinese(Hong Kong)
en.summary: Add Traditional Chinese(Hong Kong) support for the game.
en.description:
Make the official Traditional Chinese more idiomatic to Hong Kong people and fix some suspected AI slop translations.
Updating as I play.
